report:
Reviewed the complete fresh crates.sage_ir.types.body.elaborated claim and its one implementation association and three tests. Requirements: completed bodies consume method syntax and temporary adjustment recipes; implicit borrows, dereferences and coercions appear as explicit typed nodes; successful output has no source-shaped unresolved-operation placeholder; structured control flow remains a tree without basic blocks, drop schedules, generator lowering or borrow-check results. Captured relevant typed-IR design and accepted architectural rationale, current expression representation, and test fixtures/helpers.

The sole implementation association is an explicit TODO in sage_meta::todo in representation_spec.rs, explaining that source-shaped TyExprData variants remain for unsupported constructs and complete elaboration/whole-tree rejection tests are pending. The similarly named test is an empty, explanatory TODO. It supplies no behavioral assertions. The captured current TyExprData confirms explicit Ref, Deref, NeverToAny and ResolvedCall forms alongside MethodCall, IfLet, WhileLet, For, Await, Index, MacroCall, Unresolved and Missing forms. TyExpr carries a type and source span. Thus partial elaboration representation exists but the universal successful-output invariant is not established merely by the schema. The claim's complete implementation remains honestly deferred; existence of transitional variants is not itself treated as proof that every successful body exposes them.

Ordinary comparison test: comparisons_materialize_signature_required_shared_borrows opens actual checked equal/less bodies, requires no diagnostics, requires ResolvedCall, asserts eq/lt and PartialEq/PartialOrd symbol names and static-trait dispatch, checks Bool result, requires exactly two operands, and checks each operand is an explicit shared Ref with a shared reference type and Dummy lifetime. Its callback executes for both helper invocations. Its outer empty-vector assertion adds no diagnostic evidence beyond the substantive inner assertions. This is meaningful coverage of signature-required typed borrows and consumed comparison syntax, not general coercion or whole-tree rejection coverage.

Ordinary clone test: clone_method_call_is_elaborated_to_a_resolved_trait_call checks the actual DbDropGuard::db body for no diagnostics, a resolved clone call, Clone static-trait dispatch, ADT Self, and exactly one receiver. It then traverses the receiver as explicit shared reference, resolved field owned by DbDropGuard, explicit dereference, and local path, and checks the field type equals the call Self type. This directly exercises consumption of self.db.clone() method syntax and materialized receiver operations instead of an adjustment recipe. It does not assert every possible method family or coercion. The ADT check alone does not name the Self definition; no stronger identity claim is credited.

Helper dependencies: the clone fixture's BuiltinDeriveTcx supplies explicit Clone/Sized metadata, associated clone identity, and a shared-reference receiver signature; real Sage source checking produces the inspected tree. File helpers create the source/root and invoke callbacks on the supplied database; local_function_named locates the actual local definition. The comparison fixture contains u32 equality/ordering; with_proxy_database supplies live rustc metadata while Sage computes its own checked bodies. assert_symbol_name compares actual symbol names. These helpers do not hide the assertions in either test.

Remaining scope: the explicit TODO retains complete method/adjustment consumption, general coercion elaboration, and whole-tree rejection of unresolved source operations. The current tree schema and architectural rationale support the intended high-level control-flow boundary, but the two ordinary tests do not exhaustively demonstrate all control-flow forms or exclusion of basic blocks, drop schedules, generator lowering and borrow-check results. Full tree fixtures and completion validation across supported/unsupported constructs are prerequisites for replacing the TODO. No new lower-level lowering is required; it is explicitly excluded by the claim. No N/A exemption or weakened specification is used.

Validation was source inspection through fresh review start/read. No source edits or behavioral tests were performed; central suites are separate execution evidence. No requested edits: partial ordinary tests remain valuable while the explicit implementation and test TODO preserve the incomplete universal guarantee.
